panels.shot: Freight headlights fill the frame from behind. Switch lies across the rails, beaten. Elias pulls her clear by the collar at the last second. Sparks, wind in his coat.

lines.text: I didn't save her. I needed her to talk.

panels.shot: Close-up. A gold casino chip in her shaking palm, lit by a passing car's lamp: ORFEO - Reserved: the Count.

lines.speaker: Switch
lines.text: Paid in chips. Count Brask's chips. Now let me go.

panels.shot: Low angle in the signal box. Elias picks up the fallen clock. Bell & Sons, hands stopped at 3:17. He puts it back on the shelf.

lines.text: Every clock Bell made stopped at the same minute. I told myself it was the fire.

panels.shot: Exterior, night. Elias rises out of a vent grate into neon rain, Nero jumping out behind him. Across the river the Grand Casino Orfeo glows gold and red.

lines.text: The Orfeo. The house always wins. Tonight it would lose.

panels.shot: A payphone on the corner by the grate rings. Elias picks it up. Cut-in: Inspector Hale in a phone booth, hat brim low.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Brask doesn't see walk-ins. Bring a Choir coin. And Grave... keep your head down.
